title: Cone filling inside a subspace: an integer multiplicity cycle with compact support in a linear subspace V bounds an integer multiplicity current with compact support in V
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < m → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → BoundaryVanishes X → IsCompact X.support → X.support ⊆ (V : Set (Euclid P)) → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ Y.boundary = X ∧ IsCompact Y.support ∧ Y.support ⊆ (V : Set (Euclid P))
